payload.name: ExtractExplicitPrimaryGoal
payload.description: When a user explicitly states a primary goal, priority, or most important objective, create a plan memory candidate for it.
content: During candidate extraction, when a speaker explicitly states their primary goal or top priority (e.g., 'my number one goal is X', 'the most important thing to me is X'), create a memory candidate of type `plan` that captures the goal, even if it is mentioned alongside other topics. Do not omit it because the statement is embedded in conversational text.
When such a goal is stated for a specific area (career, hobby, etc.), include that context in the memory content so the goal is retrievable for future questions about that area.

solves: When a user explicitly states a primary goal or top priority in any domain (career, hobby, etc.), the construction agent may fail to extract it if it appears within a longer conversational turn. This rule ensures such explicit goal statements are always captured as a plan memory. It applies to explicit first-person goal statements, not to third-party goals, hypotheticals, or general preferences without stated importance.
